summary.intent: Execute Phase 34 (E2E Test Expansion & Staging Baselines) using wave-based parallel execution, capturing real staging performance baselines including journey timing, sustained load (200 clients), and BYO-IPFS (Pinata) capacity tests.
summary.outcome: Phase 34 completed with all 4 plans executed: cleanup helpers wired into 10 specs, media/streaming and batch download E2E suites added (16 new tests), and staging baselines captured. Real 200-client sustained load baselines obtained (11,174 ops, 0.17% error rate). Pinata integration confirmed working (p50=718ms) but CipherBox BYO registration API returns 400s.

repo: Playwright config did not respect BASE_URL env var for staging runs — baseURL was hardcoded to localhost:5173. Fixed by reading process.env.BASE_URL in playwright.config.ts and conditionally skipping webServer.
Web3Auth SDK initialization on staging takes ~22.7s; journey-timing spec had a 20s timeout on wallet-login-button that caused false failures. Vault load after auth is only 142ms.
Cleanup helper deleteAccountViaPage was hardcoded to localhost:3000 for API calls — fails on staging because the API URL must be derived from the page's current origin.
Vitest does not auto-load .env files — requires explicit shell sourcing (source .env && npx vitest) or dotenv setup. loadEnv is a Vite export, not available standalone in vitest config.

The staging throttle bypass (X-Throttle-Bypass-Secret header) works correctly end-to-end via curl and Node.js fetch. The earlier 429 failures were caused by running two load test suites simultaneously, saturating the staging API — not a bypass mechanism bug.
Pinata free tier storage limits are easily exhausted by load testing. Running byo-capacity-ceiling across 50→1000 client tiers consumed the entire free quota. Need a paid plan for real BYO baselines.

BYO-IPFS register-cid and ipns-publish return 400 on staging when using the Pinata provider — Pinata pinning succeeds (p50=718ms) but CipherBox API rejects CID registration, likely test accounts not configured for BYO mode.

code.finding: Added process.env.BASE_URL support to baseURL and conditional webServer skip when targeting staging/external URLs.
Increased wallet-login-button visibility timeout from 20s to 45s to accommodate Web3Auth's ~22.7s init time on staging.
Fixed API URL detection to derive from page origin (page.url()) instead of hardcoded localhost:3000 — required for staging runs.
No dotenv loading — vitest workers inherit env only from shell. Fixed by sourcing .env before invoking vitest.
200-client baseline: createFolder p50=6.5s p95=11.9s, uploadFile p50=8.1s p95=11.6s, deleteItem p50=3.2s. 0.17% error rate across 11,174 ops.
Staging journey baselines: login-to-vault 22,889ms (auth 22,747ms + vault 142ms), upload-to-visible 906ms, share-to-accessible 1,483ms.

workflow: Cherry-picking from worktree branches requires careful conflict resolution on STATE.md — each subagent writes its own state update, causing merge conflicts on every cherry-pick.
Running multiple load test suites simultaneously against the same staging instance causes apparent throttle failures even with bypass headers — always run load tests sequentially.
The classifyHandoffIfNeeded Claude Code bug fires in the completion handler after all tool calls finish — spot-check SUMMARY.md + git commits to determine real success/failure.
Git lock files (.git/index.lock) can appear after worktree agents abort — use git worktree prune and manual lock removal before retrying.
When diagnosing suspected env/network issues, always reproduce the exact failure in isolation (single Node.js script) before attributing to framework-level bugs.

friction: Cherry-picking commits from multiple worktree branches caused repeated STATE.md merge conflicts, requiring manual resolution on every plan merge.
Playwright config BASE_URL was not respected — required code fix before staging tests could run at all.
Web3Auth 22s init time exceeded the existing 20s test timeout, causing false journey-timing failures that looked like staging app failures.
Two load tests ran simultaneously (by design in the plan) and saturated staging, producing misleading 429 errors that looked like a bypass mechanism bug — led to extensive unnecessary debugging.
Vitest does not load .env files by default, causing all BYO tests to skip silently with 'BYO_IPFS_ENDPOINT not set' — required workaround.
Pinata free tier quota was exhausted by the capacity ceiling test, preventing real BYO pin baselines.
1Password SSH signing failed during todo commit, requiring direct git commit fallback.
Phase was prematurely marked complete and a 34.1 phase was incorrectly inserted before the user clarified scope — both had to be reverted.
open_items: BYO-IPFS register-cid and ipns-publish return 400 on staging — tracked in .planning/todos/pending/2026-03-29-debug-byo-ipfs-register-cid-400-errors-on-staging.md. Likely test accounts not configured for BYO mode or API endpoint expects different parameters.
Real BYO Pinata capacity baselines not captured — Pinata free tier exhausted. Needs paid plan or fresh account to run byo-capacity-ceiling with successful pin operations.
New media/streaming E2E specs (streaming-playback.spec.ts, media-preview.spec.ts) use binary stub fixtures — need live environment run to validate they trigger correct AES-CTR/GCM code paths.
SDK load test account creation batching may need tuning — 200 accounts took 38.7s, and running >200 concurrent clients risks hitting staging limits even with bypass header.
